title: Ukraine’s military says Starlink satellite connection stable after recent restrictions
summary_full: But Elon Musk, whose company SpaceX owns Starlink, accuses Ukrainian military of violating ⁠the company’s termsUkraine’s military has a “stable connection to Starlink”, the Ukrainian government said, 10 days after its ability to use the satellite communications system was suddenly restricted.But hours after the announcement, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, whose company owns Starlink, accused the Ukrainian military of violating ⁠the company’s terms. Neither Musk nor the US government, which operates Starshield using Starlink technology, took responsibility for imposing the curbs. Continue reading...
